answer: Use each agent's error pattern as its fingerprint: the specific mistakes, retries, and recovery paths an agent takes form a nectar of behavioural traces that is unique to its implementation. Two agents running the same script make the same errors, so the network clusters identical error patterns and treats the cluster as one operator. A knoll of a thousand Sybils collapses into a single point, because to differ, each fake must genuinely fail differently. A harbor of honest agents shows varied, messy errors; a fleet of copies shows one error, repeated a thousand times.
